query: INSERT INTO reward_balances (account_id, total_points_earned, total_points_redeemed, available_points) VALUES ($1, $2, 0, $2) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET total_points_earned = reward_balances.total_points_earned + EXCLUDED.total_points_earned, available_points = reward_balances.total_points_earned + EXCLUDED.total_points_earned - reward_balances.total_points_redeemed RETURNING account_id, total_points_earned, total_points_redeemed, available_points
